_comment: Hand pins for DAT ids whose page the automatic binder cannot reach, and
only for those. Each was looked at individually; nothing is guessed.
THREE SHAPES LIVE HERE, and they are different problems:
1. ONE PAGE, SEVERAL DAT IDS. 'Bastok Mission 2-3' has
|Mission Name=The Emissary while the DAT carries 'The Emissary
(San d'Oria)' and 'The Emissary (Windurst)' -- the same mission with
two destinations, which the client tracks separately and the wiki
documents once. mission_identity REFUSES this as ambiguous, which is
right: a binder that picked one would silently drop the other. The
split is a reading decision, so it is made here, by hand, with the
branch named.
2. A REDIRECT STUB. The DAT name is a real page title that redirects to
the article: 'The Chains That Bind Us' -> 'Bastok Mission 8-1'. The
stub carries no walkthrough, so the binder sees nothing to bind.
3. A PAGE STAGE A REJECTED for its own reasons -- no recognised header
template, or a title that binds to no DAT name.
`page` is the title whose CONTENT should be read. `branch` is free text
shown to the author to say which half of a shared page this record is,
and is null where the page describes one mission.
Every entry costs a marker if it is wrong, so each carries `why`.
